source_snapshot.procedure: Enable persistence, run level 4, then start service.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Resolve scope and define per-GPU numeric throughput plus health oracle.

old_problem: DeepSeek used undocumented level 8, while a generic PASS supplied no pinned minimum bandwidth, topology/clock context, raw per-GPU throughput or integrity/health correlation.
disposition_reason: NVIDIA documents canonical `memory_bandwidth` in levels 3 and 4 and exposes a minimum-bandwidth configuration. Source level 4 is authoritative; the pinned DCGM SKU/config supplies the numeric oracle instead of inventing a threshold.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row366 all 18 XLSX columns and history2961.
Applied official memory-bandwidth plugin selection and threshold semantics.
No memory-bandwidth workload, service or persistence change occurred.

test_case.purpose: Measure every selected GPU's local memory bandwidth under pinned topology, clocks and power state, and require the named plugin's approved floor with clean integrity/health.
required_package: Pinned DCGM/driver/GPU SKU config and reviewed memory-bandwidth script/hash
Topology, memory type/capacity, clock and power-state baseline
Per-GPU minimum bandwidth/units/tolerance from approved config
Workload drain and thermal/power/ECC/XID recovery policy
test_case.test_command: Drain selected GPUs, capture topology/clocks/power/memory health and preserve logs; establish approved DCGM state, run the pinned source-level-4 suite once, retain raw memory_bandwidth samples and all results, compare with signed floors, then restore state.
test_case.expected_result: Every GPU's valid raw bandwidth statistic meets its pinned minimum with correct units and workload shape, all expected level-4 tests pass, and no integrity, ECC, XID, retirement, PCIe, thermal or power regression occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the signed numeric floor and raw per-GPU statistic plus complete health/suite evidence; no approved threshold means no PASS, and undocumented level 8 cannot substitute.
safety_gate: Workload-owner drain and exclusive target memory
Preserve error counters and monitor thermals/power
Abort on integrity/health excursion and never auto-retry
expected_evidence: Raw bandwidth samples/statistic/units and threshold calculations
Pre/post integrity and health plus restored runtime
test_case.recovery: Abort on integrity or health fault, restore only service/persistence state, isolate the affected UUID if degraded, verify memory/GPU/host health and do not rerun automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Official canonical plugin and level-4 membership resolve scope; undocumented DeepSeek level 8 is rejected.

blocked.reason: Performance semantics are documented; the signed SKU/config threshold is a runtime prerequisite.
